lines.6: Damn it, I lost sight of her.
lines.7: There was no guarantee she'd gone to the classroom in her current state.
lines.9: It was hard to imagine she'd stayed inside the school.
lines.12: Through the downpour, I spotted a figure wandering toward Matsukasa Park without even an umbrella.
lines.14: Yoshimi kept walking unsteadily through the pounding rain.
lines.15: 「Ahaha... What a crazy rain... It actually feels kind of nice...」
lines.16: 「Wash away... Let my filthy heart just wash away...」
lines.17: There was nothing but the sea ahead of her.
lines.18: 「Leo hates me now... so there's nothing left for me to cling to.」
lines.24: 「Leo... Why did you come after me?」
lines.25: 「You... Even now you're still saying things like that...」
lines.26: 「I love you! I haven't given up on you at all!」
lines.27: I grabbed her and hugged her with all my strength.
lines.29: 「I've told you over and over and you still won't understand, so I'm showing you instead.」
lines.30: 「It's okay, Leo... I don't understand how close I'm supposed to be to other people...」
lines.31: 「I can handle a fixed distance... but if I get even a little too close... I want them all to myself... and I stop knowing what I'm doing.」
lines.32: 「Everyone else manages it so well... They're amazing.」
lines.33: 「I can't manage it either. Nobody has that figured out perfectly...」
lines.34: 「I don't care anymore... about myself, I mean.」
lines.35: 「Don't give me that. You made me fall for you and now you're saying you don't care? That's way too selfish!」
lines.36: 「But everything I do is calculated... I put on a smile... I'm what people call a bad woman. You don't want someone like that, do you?」
lines.37: 「You're not some wicked woman. You're just scared of people!」
lines.38: 「Don't call yourself evil over that. Actual villains would probably be offended.」
lines.40: 「And when you were told it was wrong, you realized it and regretted it. That's enough.」
lines.45: 「If I were lying, would I chase you through rain like this...?」
lines.46: 「It's July and this rain is freezing.」
lines.48: 「No. Screw that. After all the ways you tried to keep me to yourself?」
lines.55: 「Too bad. Trying to make me hate you isn't going to work.」
